race.comment: The well-related EDGE OF INFINITY (7) (half to G2 winner and 2xG1 placed Osipenko) has hit the top-five in all four runs this preparation and looks to be building up to a maiden victory. Drawn to get a cosy run in transit from the inside marble and should be right there when the judge calls a halt. SECRET ROSE (10) will be ready to peak now third run back from the break and this is not an overly strong affair. Can play a role without surprising. ZAYYANO (6) also hails from a handy family (half to 2xG1 winner Grunt) and has placed over this course and distance. In the mix. DUN DARTE CHEAP (4) just missed the frame when resuming and will have come on with that run now in the locker. A must for the multiples. PEARL OF SICILY (9) next in line with the 3kg claim.
